decks.notes: This Boros Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creature plays and burn spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent and deal damage. The inclusion of Jegantha as a companion allows for extra mana ramp and consistency. The deck aims to establish board control with cards like Static Prison and then finish off the opponent with powerful creatures like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Ajani, Nacatl Pariah. Overall, the strategy is to maintain a fast-paced aggressive approach to win the game before the opponent can stabilize.

The Boros Aggro deck focuses on using aggressive creatures like Galvanic Discharge, Amped Raptor, and Ajani, Nacatl Pariah to quickly deal damage to the opponent. The deck also includes support cards like Static Prison and Ocelot Pride to control the board and protect your creatures. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides additional mana ramp and versatility to the deck. Overall, the key concept of this deck is to overwhelm your opponent with fast and efficient creatures while maintaining control of the battlefield.
